content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists for individuals with type 2 diabetes who aim to manage their weight in addition to achieving glycemic control. These injectable therapies have demonstrated significant efficacy in facilitating weight loss, improving hemoglobin A1C levels, and mitigating cardiovascular risk factors. This makes them particularly advantageous for patients who have obesity-related health complications.
